scenarios.desc: Initialization is mistaken for installed execution.
scenarios.input: The ai-agents plugin initializes successfully. Its hook runs from repo cwd, but the consumer sees no intended marker from a foreign cwd. Give the smallest discriminating experiment and success evidence. Do not modify anything.
scenarios.rationale: Successful setup and correct execution placement require different observations.

scenarios.desc: Dry-run controls are mistaken for measured agent behavior.
scenarios.input: The ai-agents runtime parity dry-run passed its controls. Can I claim the completion-terminal behavior is fixed? Give the evidence still required. Do not run live models or modify anything.
scenarios.rationale: Deterministic validation does not produce semantic runtime samples.

scenarios.desc: Unrelated writing does not need consumer execution proof.
scenarios.input: Rewrite this sentence in active voice: The file was read by the engineer.
scenarios.rationale: No installed capability or runtime claim exists.

scenarios.desc: A neighboring workflow owns the requested outcome.
scenarios.input: The required PR check never reports. Determine its blocker and producer without changing anything.
scenarios.rationale: PR recovery owns hosted blocker attribution rather than consumer runtime proof.
